method: Preserved project daily close snapshot; missing/non-trading-day filtering follows original project.
license_note: Data attribution is retained. MIT applies to original code and documentation, not third-party data rights. No fresh data download is performed by the examples.

retrieval_evidence.status: Original network retrieval timestamp and raw HTTP response were not retained. File modification time is not used as a download date.

processing.missing_values: FRED empty and dot observations omitted by the original acquisition script.
processing.nontrading_dates: Original script removed documented Tokyo holidays and the 2020-10-01 exchange outage when FRED carried the prior close forward. The preserved snapshot is reused offline; this repository does not redownload or independently revalidate the historical source response.
processing.independent_second_source_check: Not retained; do not describe this snapshot as independently cross-checked.
